name: Community Rating
description: Shows view and favorite totals from active Jellyfin members on media cards and detail pages.
overview: Aggregates played and favorite markers across active, included Jellyfin accounts, with optional administrator-only member name tooltips.

versions.changelog: Fix member sort options in both Jellyfin sort menus, including late-loaded menus, folder lists, pagination, filters, and saved selections.
Initial release: member views and favorites, configurable card layout, library sorting, administrator tooltips, and scheduled reconciliation.
